sources.title: Immigration (Visa) Order: current revised-law record
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Revised Laws record identifies the Immigration (Visa) Order and records its amendment by S.I. 134/2020 as in force on 7 September 2020.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Amended by S.I. 134/2020 .. in force 7 September 2020.

sources.title: Immigration (Visa) Order, section 3: visa requirement and timing
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Revised Laws section makes Schedule 2 an arrival-issued route and Schedule 3 a pre-arrival route for a passport requiring a visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Where the person ... is ... listed in Schedule 3, the person shall obtain the visa prior to arrival in Saint Lucia.

sources.title: Immigration (Visa) Order, Schedule 2: visa on arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Schedule 2 is a statutory nationality list whose citizens may be issued a visa on arrival; its continuing Georgia entry is materially ambiguous beside the later pending ordinary-passport waiver legislation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: COUNTRIES WHOSE SUBJECTS OR CITIZENS MAY BE ISSUED A VISA ON ARRIVAL IN SAINT LUCIA

sources.title: Immigration (Visa) Order, Schedule 3: visa prior to arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Schedule 3 expressly lists the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the pre-arrival cohort, while Schedule 2 separately retains the legacy 'Zaire' arrival cohort; no official source reconciles the identities.
sources.supportingExcerpt: COUNTRIES WHOSE SUBJECTS OR CITIZENS REQUIRE A VISA PRIOR TO ARRIVAL IN SAINT LUCIA

sources.title: Apply for Saint Lucia Non-Immigrant Visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, International Trade, Civil Aviation and Diaspora Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry service describes a normal pre-travel application and only a case-specific, potentially refused airport application; it cannot supply a Schedule-1-only nationality baseline.
sources.supportingExcerpt: In some circumstances, application for a visa can be made at the airport on entry to Saint Lucia.

sources.title: Saint Lucia, Georgia conclude visa waiver agreement
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Saint Lucia
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official announcement records a concluded Georgia waiver agreement but supplies no entry-into-force date; later parliamentary materials show the agreement was still at First Reading.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The agreement will facilitate the travel of nationals of the two countries to each other’s territory without a visa.

sources.title: House of Assembly Order Paper, Tuesday 19 August 2025
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Order Paper dated 19 August 2025 lists the Georgia ordinary/diplomatic/official/service passport visa-exemption agreement for First Reading, not a completed entry-into-force act.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Agreement Between Government of Saint Lucia and Government of Georgia on Visa Exemption ... First Reading
